exposure: Risk factors associated with necrotizing enterocolitis
outcome: Need for surgery in infants with necrotizing enterocolitis (Surgical NEC)
cohort: Infants diagnosed with necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) who were divided into surgical and non-surgical groups.
finding: A CatBoost machine learning model, built with 14 features, performed better than a logistic regression model and accurately identified surgical NEC in internal validation (AUC = 0.905).
